summary: Base-game items that the worlds Underground City makes do not supply: no villages (carrots, potatoes, beetroot), no taiga or lush caves on the archipelago (sweet berries, glow berries) and no Nether in play (quartz, and so comparators, observers and daylight detectors). Each root anything needs must be sold somewhere a player can walk to: a city exchange line or a shopkeeper's counter, from a small finite shelf. scripts/audit_item_sources.py enforces it; before this catalogue the audit took every minecraft: item as obtainable at level 1, and the first-hour audit of October 25 found berries, beetroot and quartz had no source at all.

routes_kinds.sold: sold by a finite, shared supplier line: a city exchange line or the counter of a shopkeeper (shop:<kind>, in a city or at a roadside place)
routes_kinds.derived: crafted from another root that has a route, by a base-game recipe

minecraft:carrot.gameplay: the Grading Table's produce crate, greenhouse wholesale

route.why: Valewood's general store and the Harrow farm stand; a carrot planted grows more.

minecraft:potato.gameplay: the Grading Table's produce crate, greenhouse wholesale

route.why: Valewood's general store and the Harrow farm stand; a potato planted grows more.

minecraft:beetroot_seeds.gameplay: beetroot for the Mill's beet sugar and the Grading Table

route.why: The Harrow farm stand sells beet seed by the handful.

minecraft:beetroot.gameplay: the Mill's beet sugar, the Grading Table's beet crate

route.why: grown from the farm stand's seed

minecraft:sweet_berries.absent_because: taiga only, and the archipelago has none
minecraft:sweet_berries.gameplay: berry wine at the Fermentation Vat, the Grading Table's fruit crate

route.why: Valewood's general store and the Harrow farm stand; a berry planted grows a bush.

minecraft:glow_berries.absent_because: lush caves only, and the archipelago's terrain has none
minecraft:glow_berries.gameplay: glow wine at the Fermentation Vat

minecraft:quartz.absent_because: the Nether, which is not part of play
minecraft:quartz.gameplay: comparators, observers and daylight detectors for five Technician orders

route.why: Blackwater's exchange and Kessler Salvage, small shelves.
